title: Touché: Enhancing Touch Interaction on Humans, Screens, Liquids, and Everyday Objects
summary: Disney Research presents Touche, a swept frequency capacitive sensing technique that recognizes complex hand and body configurations, and adds touch sensitivity to humans, liquids and everyday objects.
why: Brought up as an early example of context-aware touch sensing and as part of Disney Research's wider interaction prototypes.

quote.text: Basically the idea is to make devices aware of the physical context of user interactions.
